semantic_variant_classification: Only canonical nodes are unchanged upstream. Named cast/transpose code derivatives and attribute/data mutations are explicit controls. Every step rebuilds fresh functions/classes/selector objects; no cached global rebinding.
wrong_mechanism_probes: For every expected control: wrong exact exception type, correct type/wrong message, and no exception. Unrelated errors are HARNESS_FAILURE, never intended detection.
optional_cast_gap_policy: Single omissions can be numerically masked by mixed-operand promotion; never call those discriminating if outputs pass. Omitted-both fixture has predeclared scalar BF16-rounding separation; unsupported/no-separation remains explicitly unqualified. Mandatory FP32 controls have no survivor allowance.
native_unsupported_predicate: Exact ValueError/RuntimeError/TypeError with bfloat16 or bfloat plus unsupported/not support/unavailable; bank actual exception and execution/evaluation count, no acceptance by arbitrary exception.
